summary: Li Bang International (Cayman FPI, PRC operations) disclosed a Nov 3, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement under which wholly-owned PRC subsidiary Jiangsu Libang Intelligent Technology will acquire 50.1% of Jiangsu Xinsheng Synthetic Materials from two individual sellers, giving control of a chemical raw-materials supplier. Consideration is US$23.0 million cash plus 2,000,000 Class A shares, issued unregistered under Regulation S and/or Section 4(a)(2) with lock-up and performance-based leak-out. Cash pays in three installments (US$3.0 million at First Closing within ten business days); equity transfers staged across three closings. A three-year reverse-split top-up preserves the sellers' 2,000,000-share count. Watch staged-closing and equity-overhang risk.
